provenanceLimits: This is a read-only aggregation of existing isolated tests, not a new test run or application/edition/business acceptance.
Each command snapshots an explicit owner/test set, not every transitive loaded module. Captured byte hashes are checked exactly; absent runtime hashes are not invented.

The static dependency graph conservatively follows local import/export/require literals and explicit repository file literals; it can include mocked or unreachable modules. Computed imports, all package internals, and actual Vite runtime import traces are not reconstructed.

Filesystem modification time is only a review signal, not cryptographic proof of historical contents. Uncaptured later modifications are listed separately for scope review; they are not silently reported as current-byte test passes.

All earlier file runs, including the old Designer runtime_data_isolation failure, remain in raw provenance. The final current-source union replaces every selected edition/file, without relabeling any old run exit status.
